dogecoin.text:
one of my most contrarian views is that proof-of-work makes a comeback

the pendulum shifted in favor of PoS too quickly; as ethereum and other PoS chains mature, we're running into a ton of unforeseen PoS problems

for context, dogecoin is the #2 PoW chain by market cap

if anything resembling agi is coming in the next few years, here is the ordered ranking of asset classes you want to be understanding and investing in:

1 - the actual agi company
2 - bitcoin 
…
5 - memetic assets (dogecoin, xrp)
…
100 - SME B2B SAAS fintech in southeast asia
